text:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-preemptible-3: 6/8 preemptible GPUs lost in us-west2. autoscaler reported partial failure. queue length spiking for /v1/generate, error rate rising. paging oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-carlos: acked. jumping in. what are current queue numbers?

telemetry-bot: metrics snapshot: queue_size=/v1/generate=2,100 reqs, 90th latency=4.2s (baseline 0.6s), 5xx rate=12%. gpu-pool-preemptible-3 utilization=95% before preemptions, now nodes DOWN=6, available GPUs=2.

sre-amy: seeing autoscaler logs => `error: scale up failed: quotaExceeded: Insufficient GPU quota in project-redwood-usw2`. autoscaler retried 3x then backed off.

oncall-carlos: runbook step 1: enable fallback pool, step 2: route to dedicated if available. who owns dedicated routing?

runtime-lee: I can flip routing policy for affected customer-tenant groups. but dedicated capacity is limited. we can also force model-variant fallback to smaller quantized models to reduce GPU mem and improve throughput.

mlops-jordan: suggest immediate model fallback for non-SLA tenants and reduce batch_size to 1 for high-latency tail customers. quick command: `curl -XPOST https://console.internal/api/route/fallback -d '{"pool":"quantized-small","selector":"non-sla"}'`

support-kate: customer report inbound: ACME Corp noticed 50% failed requests since 08:12. ticket #INC-4491 opened. they're impacted on chat completions.

infra-lina: I can request emergency quota bump but that takes ~25-40m with cloud provider. meanwhile we can hot-attach reserved-dedicated-01 if approved. need sign-off.

oncall-carlos: approve hot-attach reserved-dedicated-01 for 30m. do it. :thumbsup:

infra-lina: initiating attach. `gcloud compute instances attach gpu-pool-dedicated-01 --zone=us-west2` — starting.

telemetry-bot: update: after attach begins, queue_size now 1,900. 5xx down to 8%. new GPUs initializing (2/8 ready).

sre-amy: autoscaler finally succeeded on a partial scale after quota bump request returned soft-approval token; however, a bug in the autoscaler leader lease prevented applying new nodes to the queue fast enough. pushing a hotfix to leader election: `kubectl apply -f autoscaler-leader-fix.yaml`

runtime-lee: pushed variant fallback for `*non-sla*` tenants. models switched to `gpt-small-q4_0` for low priority traffic. this reduced per-request GPU memory by ~40%.

mlops-jordan: can we also enable aggressive prefix caching for repeated prompts from few high-volume tenants? that would drop token generation load quickly.

runtime-lee: enabled prefix cache TTL=600s for heavy tenants.

support-kate: ACME confirms partial recovery, errors down from 50% to ~6%. still seeing higher latency. they're asking for root cause timeline.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated fallback policy triggered: route_to=dedicated, variant_fallback=quantized-small, cache_enabled=true.

oncall-carlos: status check: what's open tasks?

- infra-lina: finish attach and confirm nodes healthy.
- sre-amy: monitor leader-fix rollout and confirm autoscaler stabilizes.
- runtime-lee: confirm no correctness regressions from quantized variant for top customers.
- support-kate: collect impacted customer list and update INC-4491.

sre-amy: autoscaler leader-fix rollout complete at 08:28. new nodes drained queued work and started accepting traffic. autoscaler logs: `scaled_to=+6_gpus`.

telemetry-bot: metrics: queue_size=140, 5xx=1.2%, 90th latency=1.1s. GPU utilization stable ~72%.

runtime-lee: rolling back variant fallback for SLA tenants only (kept for non-sla). tested 20 sample requests => outputs comparable.

support-kate: ACME updated: they see normal behavior now, will keep ticket open for 2h to confirm.

mlops-jordan: note: we saw repeated preemptible interruptions in us-west2 preemptible pool 3. recommend immediate follow-ups: 1) expand non-preemptible reserved pool, 2) review autoscaler error handling for quotaExceeded, 3) improve fallback routing prioritization so canary/critical traffic moves faster.

infra-lina: placing expedited quota increase request with provider; also opening procurement ticket for more reserved GPUs for Dedicated.

oncall-carlos: marking incident as "mitigated" at 08:31. will create a short postmortem and follow-up action items. thanks all. :clap:

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED: gpu-pool-preemptible-3 - mitigation confirmed, affected traffic routed, and autoscaler stabilized.

sre-amy: quick retrospective notes to add to postmortem draft: 
- primary cause: sudden preemption wave in preemptible pool + insufficient immediate fallback capacity.
- contributing: autoscaler didn't escalate quota failure quickly to routing layer; leader lease bug slowed node assignment.
- quick mitigations used: attach dedicated reserve, model-variant fallback, prefix caching, temporary batch size changes.
- long-term actions: increase reserved non-preemptible pool, add explicit quota-failure routing path, faster leader election fallback, improve preemptible health probing.

oncall-carlos: I'm creating the postmortem doc and will assign owners. tagging @eng-runtime @eng-infra @eng-sre for follow-ups.

support-kate: closing loop with ACME, adding incident summary to the ticket.

telemetry-bot: final snapshot at 08:39: queue_size=12, 5xx=0.2%, 90th latency=0.62s.

mlops-jordan: +1 for running a synthetic regression check against the quantized variant before full autopromotion next time.

oncall-carlos: incident closed at 08:39. follow-ups assigned. thanks team.

sre-amy: filing postmortem draft: https://docs.internal/incidents/2933337777-postmortem-draft (will share once fleshed out).
